spec: How people retell the world's generated history (sim/history-voice). A retelling = opener (by how the teller knows it and how long ago it was) + the beat's summary + a coda (another witness, or the beat kind). Dawn lines use a short gist per beat. No runtime AI: every word comes from here or the beat tables.

deep: My people were in this one.
Our family was in the thick of it.
My grandfather told it, and he was there.
middle: I was young, but I remember.
I saw some of it myself.
I remember the smell of it still.
recent: I saw it with my own eyes.

deep: My grandmother had it from hers.
Long back, before the roads went quiet.
middle: Old enough that people argue the details.
recent: You'll have heard pieces of this.

otherWitness: {name} remembers it better than I do.

miracle: I still don't know what to make of it.
drift: Nobody noticed until it was done.
departure: The door stayed open a long while.
doctrine_arrival: It's still posted, more or less.
We learned the words by heart.

dawn: {teller} kept everyone up at the fire with {gist}.
Down by the well, {teller} was going on about {gist} again.
{teller} told the story of {gist} last night, and nobody interrupted.
